description: The Phase-1 API surface on top of FEAT-001's schema/catalogue/migration: the minimal additive auth departmentScope extension, the one-line allowance-engine departmentId:null hardening, the new zod validation schemas, the CalendarService read API, the academic-session state-machine service, the admin CRUD + session/term lifecycle routes, the rewritten generalized calendar handlers (writing append-only revisions), and the non-admin read endpoints. All academics routes are permission-gated ONLY (never requireModuleActive — Decision A), go through withTenant, and audit via recordAuditEvent in-transaction. Preserve-history by construction (status-only lifecycle, promotion seam modelled not executed). Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the migrated schema + the academics.* catalogue keys).
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST, plus design.md §4.4,§5,§6,§11,§13. Read apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts calendar handlers, apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts, apps/api/src/services/allowance-engine.ts, apps/api/src/services/audit.ts, and apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/admin-config-calendar.integration.test.ts for the live patterns.

apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts: add departmentScope: string | null to RequestAuth; add departmentScope: true to the tenant-actor membership select; set departmentScope: membership.departmentScope in the tenant-actor request.auth branch and departmentScope: null in the SUPER_ADMIN branch. Additive, read-only — change no existing auth decision or token shape.

apps/api/src/services/allowance-engine.ts: add departmentId: null to the academicCalendarDay.findMany where in getRemainingAllowance (institution-wide only; behavior-preserving on existing data, deterministic via the _inst_date_institutionwide partial unique). Change nothing else in the engine; do NOT refactor it onto CalendarService.

packages/shared/src/validation.ts: add createAcademicSessionSchema (name 1-100, structureType enum, startDate/endDate required, refine start<end), createAcademicTermSchema (name 1-100, ordinal int>=1, startDate/endDate required, academicSessionId required), createProgramSchema (departmentId required, name 1-200, code 1-32, duration int 1-20, durationUnit enum default TERMS), and EXTEND upsertAcademicCalendarDaySchema with optional departmentId/academicSessionId/academicTermId (additive). Rebuild shared: cd packages/shared && npx tsc.

apps/api/src/services/calendar-service.ts (NEW): CalendarEntry interface + CalendarService.getEntries(institutionId, from, to, db, opts?) and effectiveDayType(institutionId, date, db, opts?) per design §4.4, with the department-wins precedence rule. Runs on a passed Prisma.TransactionClient (RLS-scoped); never reads cross-tenant. Keep the precedence resolution a pure function over fetched rows so it is unit-testable without a DB.

apps/api/src/services/academic-session.ts (NEW): the session/term state machine — createSession, addTerm, activateSession, closeSession, and term activate/close — mirroring module-system.ts ownership. Enforce design §5.1/§5.2: PATCH only while UPCOMING (else 409 'session not editable'); activation requires >=1 term and each term startDate<endDate (else 409); exactly-one-ACTIVE (service closes the current ACTIVE on handover=true, else 409; the partial unique index is the backstop); soft warnings (term-count vs structureType suggestion, term-outside-session, term-overlap) WARN but never block. Keep transition predicates pure where possible. Lifecycle is status-only (preserve-history §6). Name the promotion seam in a comment; touch NO StudentProfile and create no enrollment rows.

apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts: add session CRUD + term CRUD + lifecycle (activate/close) under requirePermission('academics.sessions.manage'); program CRUD under requirePermission('academics.programs.manage'); and REWRITE the three live calendar handlers (GET/PUT/DELETE /academic-calendar...) to drop the gone institutionId_date compound-unique input in favour of findFirst/create/update keyed on (institutionId, date, departmentId ?? null), gate them on academics.calendar.manage, write an AcademicCalendarDayRevision row in the SAME withTenant transaction before each mutation, and audit academics.calendar.updated. All new/rewritten academics routes: withTenant, permission-gated ONLY (NO requireModuleActive), recordAuditEvent(input, tx) in-transaction. Use the success-plus-warnings envelope { <resource>, warnings: Array<{ code: string; message: string }> } (warnings [] when none).

apps/api/src/routes/student.ts: add GET /me/academic/current-session (the ACTIVE session + its terms) and GET /me/academic/calendar?startDate&endDate under requirePermission('academics.view') + withTenant, department-narrowed via CalendarService.getEntries with departmentId = request.auth.departmentScope ?? undefined. Add a code comment that these carry NO requireModuleActive hook (unlike every peer route on student.ts) because academics is foundational, not a gated module.

Compile: cd packages/shared && npx tsc, then cd apps/api && npx tsc — both clean. Record in findings any route paths/handler names and the warnings-envelope shape so FEAT-003 asserts against the real surface.
acceptance_criteria: cd packages/shared && npx tsc and cd apps/api && npx tsc both compile clean.
RequestAuth carries departmentScope and authenticate populates it (null for SUPER_ADMIN); no existing auth test regresses.
allowance-engine getRemainingAllowance reads academicCalendarDay with departmentId: null and is otherwise unchanged.
CalendarService and academic-session service exist with the signatures above; the precedence and term-count-suggestion logic are pure functions callable without a DB.

admin.ts exposes session/term/program CRUD + session/term lifecycle gated by the academics.* permissions, and the three calendar handlers are rewritten to the partial-unique-compatible find/create/update path, writing a revision row in-transaction and auditing academics.calendar.updated.
student.ts exposes the two academics read endpoints under academics.view with no requireModuleActive hook.
verification: cd c:/campusgate/apps/api && npx vitest run src/routes/__tests__/admin-config-calendar.integration.test.ts (the existing calendar regression must still pass after the handler rewrite — needs live Supabase + .env)
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. All three FEAT-002 verification commands pass: (shared) npx tsc clean; (apps/api) npx tsc clean; the calendar regression `src/routes/__tests__/admin-config-calendar.integration.test.ts` is green (4/4) after the handler rewrite. Also ran the mocked auth/authz suites (authenticate.test.ts, authz-engine.test.ts, auth-regression, login-token-shape) = 31/31 green, confirming the additive departmentScope surface regresses no existing auth decision. DB-hitting suites (allowance-integration, tenant-escape) need live Supabase + .env and are FEAT-003's scope.

AUTH: RequestAuth gained `departmentScope: string | null`; authenticate selects membership.departmentScope (tenant-actor branch) and sets null in the SUPER_ADMIN branch. Additive/read-only, no token change.

ALLOWANCE-ENGINE: added `departmentId: null` to the academicCalendarDay.findMany where in getRemainingAllowance (institution-wide only). One clause, nothing else changed.

SHARED validation.ts: added createAcademicSessionSchema, createAcademicTermSchema, createProgramSchema and extended upsertAcademicCalendarDaySchema with optional departmentId/academicSessionId/academicTermId. NOTE for FEAT-003: because .refine() yields a ZodEffects (no .partial()/.omit()), I also export the BASE object schemas `academicSessionObject` and `academicTermObject` (the routes derive .partial()/.omit() variants from these). Shared rebuilt (dist current).

NEW SERVICES:
- apps/api/src/services/calendar-service.ts: `CalendarService.getEntries(institutionId, from, to, db, opts?)` returns CalendarEntry[]; `CalendarService.effectiveDayType(institutionId, date, db, opts?)`; pure resolver `resolveEffectiveDayType(rows, departmentId?)` (department-wins precedence, DB-free). opts.departmentId => institution-wide (null) + that dept via `where.OR`.
- apps/api/src/services/academic-session.ts: pure predicates `suggestedTermCount`, `termCountWarning`, `termOutsideSessionWarning`, `termOverlapWarning`; DB transitions `activateSession(db, institutionId, sessionId, handover)`, `closeSession`, `activateTerm`, `closeTerm`. Exactly-one-ACTIVE (service closes current ACTIVE on handover=true else returns code ACTIVE_EXISTS), >=1 term + each term startDate<endDate before activate, status-only lifecycle. Promotion seam documented in the module header; touches NO StudentProfile.

WARNINGS-ENVELOPE SHAPE (FEAT-003 assert against this): every academics route returns `{ <resource>, warnings: Array<{ code: string; message: string }> }` with warnings `[]` when none. Resource key names by route: sessions list => `{ sessions, warnings }`; session create/get/patch/activate/close => `{ session, warnings }`; term create/patch/activate/close => `{ term, warnings }`; programs list => `{ programs, warnings }`; program create/patch => `{ program, warnings }`; calendar PUT => `{ calendarDay, warnings }`; calendar DELETE => `{ success: true, warnings }`; student current-session => `{ session, warnings }`; student calendar => `{ entries, warnings }`. Soft-warning codes emitted: `TERM_COUNT_SUGGESTION`, `TERM_OUTSIDE_SESSION`, `TERM_OVERLAP` (all on POST term; termCountWarning also surfaces on session activate).

REAL ROUTE PATHS (all under adminRoutes prefix /api/admin, permission-gated ONLY, NO requireModuleActive, withTenant, recordAuditEvent in-tx):
- GET  /academic/sessions                 academics.sessions.manage  (audit: none; list)
- POST /academic/sessions                 academics.sessions.manage  (academics.session.created) 201; 409 'session name exists'
- GET  /academic/sessions/:id             academics.sessions.manage  (incl. terms)
- PATCH /academic/sessions/:id            academics.sessions.manage  (academics.session.updated); 409 'session not editable' unless UPCOMING
- POST /academic/sessions/:id/terms       academics.sessions.manage  (academics.term.created) 201; 409 'ordinal exists'
- PATCH /academic/terms/:id               academics.sessions.manage  (academics.term.updated); 409 'term not editable' when CLOSED
- POST /academic/sessions/:id/activate    academics.sessions.manage  (academics.session.activated [+ academics.session.closed on handover]); 409 'invalid state'|'session needs >=1 term'|'term has invalid dates'|'active session exists; pass handover=true'. handover via ?handover=true or body {handover:true}.
- POST /academic/sessions/:id/close       academics.sessions.manage  (academics.session.closed)
- POST /academic/terms/:id/activate       academics.sessions.manage  (academics.term.activated); 409 'session not active'|'invalid state'
- POST /academic/terms/:id/close          academics.sessions.manage  (academics.term.closed)
- GET  /academic/programs                 academics.programs.manage  (?departmentId&?status)
- POST /academic/programs                 academics.programs.manage  (academics.program.created) 201; 400 'unknown department'; 409 'program code exists'
- PATCH /academic/programs/:id            academics.programs.manage  (academics.program.updated); status via body {status:'ACTIVE'|'INACTIVE'}; 409 'program code exists'
- GET    /academic-calendar               academics.calendar.manage  (?startDate&endDate&departmentId) via CalendarService.getEntries
- PUT    /academic-calendar/day           academics.calendar.manage  (academics.calendar.updated); writes AcademicCalendarDayRevision (changeType CREATE|UPDATE) in-tx before create/update keyed on (institutionId, date, departmentId ?? null)
- DELETE /academic-calendar/day/:date     academics.calendar.manage  (?departmentId) (academics.calendar.updated); writes DELETE revision in-tx before delete by id

Student routes (studentRoutes prefix, permission-gated academics.view, withTenant, NO requireModuleActive — comment in-file):
- GET /me/academic/current-session   => { session, warnings }  (ACTIVE session + terms[id,name,ordinal,status,startDate,endDate])
- GET /me/academic/calendar?startDate&endDate => { entries, warnings }; department narrowed via request.auth.departmentScope ?? undefined (never request input).

CALENDAR PERMISSION MIGRATION (design §7.3 / A3): the three calendar handlers moved from `admin.academic_calendar.manage` to the NEW `academics.calendar.manage`. ADMIN holds both keys so no admin loses access; the old key is retained in the catalogue, now route-unused. The handlers now write the NEW `academics.calendar.updated` audit key (was `admin.academic_calendar.updated`).

EXISTING-TEST MAINTENANCE (required by FEAT-002 verification, which demands the calendar regression stay green after the rewrite): updated the mock DB shape in admin-config-calendar.integration.test.ts to add academicCalendarDay.findFirst/create/update + the academicCalendarDayRevision delegate, and re-pointed the PUT/DELETE assertions from the gone institutionId_date compound-unique to the new findFirst(institutionId,date,departmentId) + revision-create + delete-by-id path. The GET assertion (findMany with institutionId) is unchanged and still passes. FEAT-003 owns NEW academics tests.

CHANGED FILES: apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts, apps/api/src/services/allowance-engine.ts, packages/shared/src/validation.ts, apps/api/src/services/calendar-service.ts (NEW), apps/api/src/services/academic-session.ts (NEW), apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts, apps/api/src/routes/student.ts, apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/admin-config-calendar.integration.test.ts.
